runtime/input_state#

The native layer under io/stdin: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under io/stdin: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Opaque mutable buffer owned by one io/stdin.Utf8Input decorator. It stores undecoded bytes and lifecycle flags, never the wrapped Reading capability.
